svg.title: Cover display: file, download and fallback

g.text: Cover display: file, download and fallback
file name from album ID + URL hash
[Download for the same path is in progress]
null; on exception remove temporary file
synchronisieren(alben) starts only if at least one cover URL is valid.
It then removes old .img/.tmp files and preloads with up to four workers.
Individual dateiFuer() calls have no global limit of four.
